tool_signatures.name: accept_alert
tool_signatures.description: Accept (OK) a JavaScript alert, confirm, or prompt dialog.

tool_signatures.name: assert_attribute
tool_signatures.description: Assert an element attribute has the expected value.

tool_signatures.name: assert_element_count
tool_signatures.description: Assert number of elements matching selector equals expected count.

tool_signatures.name: assert_element_not_visible
tool_signatures.description: Assert an element is NOT visible (hidden or absent).

tool_signatures.name: assert_element_visible
tool_signatures.description: Assert an element is visible on the page.

tool_signatures.name: assert_page_contains
tool_signatures.description: Assert the full page source or visible text contains a string.

tool_signatures.name: assert_text
tool_signatures.description: Assert element text equals or contains expected value.

tool_signatures.name: assert_title
tool_signatures.description: Assert the page title equals or contains expected text.

tool_signatures.name: assert_url
tool_signatures.description: Assert the current URL equals or contains expected value.

tool_signatures.name: check_accessibility
tool_signatures.description: Run a built-in accessibility audit on the current page. Checks for missing alt text, unlabelled inputs, empty buttons/links, missing page title, HTML lang, heading structure, and keyboard accessibility.

tool_signatures.name: clear_field
tool_signatures.description: Clear the text in an input field.

tool_signatures.name: clear_healed_locators
tool_signatures.description: Clear the self-healing locator cache so all selectors are re-evaluated from scratch.

tool_signatures.name: clear_mock_responses
tool_signatures.description: Remove all active mock response rules injected by mock_response.

tool_signatures.name: clear_session_log
tool_signatures.description: Clear the recorded action log and start fresh.

tool_signatures.name: click
tool_signatures.description: Click on an element.

tool_signatures.name: close_browser
tool_signatures.description: Close and quit the browser session.

tool_signatures.name: close_current_tab
tool_signatures.description: Close the currently active tab and switch to the previous one.

tool_signatures.name: compare_screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Compare the current page screenshot against a saved baseline. On first run (or with update_baseline=true) saves the baseline. Returns the pixel diff percentage. Install Pillow for accurate pixel comparison.

tool_signatures.name: delete_all_cookies
tool_signatures.description: Delete all cookies for the current session.

tool_signatures.name: delete_cookie
tool_signatures.description: Delete a specific cookie by name.

tool_signatures.name: detect_selenium_boot
tool_signatures.description: Detect whether the working directory is a Selenium Boot project. Call BEFORE generating Java; if detected=true use framework='selenium_boot'.

tool_signatures.name: dismiss_alert
tool_signatures.description: Dismiss (Cancel) a JavaScript confirm or prompt dialog.

tool_signatures.name: double_click
tool_signatures.description: Double-click on an element.

tool_signatures.name: drag_and_drop
tool_signatures.description: Drag one element and drop it onto another.

tool_signatures.name: emulate_device
tool_signatures.description: Emulate a mobile device using Chrome DevTools Protocol. Adjusts viewport, pixel ratio, and touch.

tool_signatures.name: execute_script
tool_signatures.description: Execute JavaScript in the browser.

tool_signatures.name: fill_form
tool_signatures.description: Fill multiple form fields in a single call. Pass a map of CSS selector → value. Automatically handles text inputs, textareas, checkboxes (true/false), radio buttons, and <select> dropdowns. Optionally clicks a submit button at the end.

tool_signatures.name: find_element
tool_signatures.description: Find an element and return its text, tag, and attributes.

tool_signatures.name: find_elements
tool_signatures.description: Find all matching elements and return their texts.

tool_signatures.name: find_shadow_element
tool_signatures.description: Find an element inside a shadow DOM. Provide the host element selector and then the selector for the element inside the shadow root.

tool_signatures.name: generate
tool_signatures.description: Generate test code or CI config from the recorded session. language: python (pytest) | java | csharp (NUnit) | gherkin (.feature + Java steps) | playwright (TS hints) | github_actions | jenkins | gitlab_ci. In a Selenium Boot project (see detect_selenium_boot) use language=java|gherkin, framework=selenium_boot.

tool_signatures.name: get_alert_text
tool_signatures.description: Return the text message of a currently open JavaScript alert/confirm/prompt.

tool_signatures.name: get_attribute
tool_signatures.description: Get an attribute value from an element.

tool_signatures.name: get_console_logs
tool_signatures.description: Return browser console logs (errors, warnings, info). Chrome only.

tool_signatures.name: get_cookies
tool_signatures.description: Return all cookies for the current page, or a single cookie by name.

tool_signatures.name: get_current_url
tool_signatures.description: Return the current URL.

tool_signatures.name: get_healed_locators
tool_signatures.description: Return all self-healed locator mappings from this session. Shows which selectors were automatically repaired and what they were replaced with.

tool_signatures.name: get_local_storage
tool_signatures.description: Get a value from localStorage, or return all keys if no key is given.

tool_signatures.name: get_network_logs
tool_signatures.description: Return captured XHR/fetch network requests (method, URL, status, timing). Chrome only.

tool_signatures.name: get_page_source
tool_signatures.description: Return the current page HTML source.

tool_signatures.name: get_page_title
tool_signatures.description: Return the current page title.

tool_signatures.name: get_session_log
tool_signatures.description: Return the raw list of recorded actions in the current session.

tool_signatures.name: get_session_storage
tool_signatures.description: Get a value from sessionStorage, or return all keys if no key is given.

tool_signatures.name: get_table_data
tool_signatures.description: Extract data from an HTML table as a formatted text grid.

tool_signatures.name: get_text
tool_signatures.description: Get the visible text content of an element.

tool_signatures.name: go_back
tool_signatures.description: Navigate back in browser history.

tool_signatures.name: go_forward
tool_signatures.description: Navigate forward in browser history.

tool_signatures.name: hover
tool_signatures.description: Hover the mouse over an element.

tool_signatures.name: inspect_page
tool_signatures.description: Discover all interactive elements on the current page — inputs, buttons, selects, checkboxes, textareas, and links — with their best CSS selectors and labels. Use this before writing locators so the AI knows exactly what's on the page.

tool_signatures.name: is_displayed
tool_signatures.description: Check if an element is visible on the page.

tool_signatures.name: is_enabled
tool_signatures.description: Check if an element is enabled (not disabled).

tool_signatures.name: list_windows
tool_signatures.description: List all open browser tabs/windows with their index, title, and URL.

tool_signatures.name: migrate
tool_signatures.description: Analyze an existing Selenium Java project for migration to Selenium Boot (read-only, via selenium-boot-migrator). Returns the JSON report: what maps cleanly and what needs manual work.

tool_signatures.name: mock_response
tool_signatures.description: Intercept fetch/XHR requests matching a URL pattern and return a canned response. Useful for testing without a real backend. Injection survives until the page is reloaded.

tool_signatures.name: navigate
tool_signatures.description: Navigate the browser to a URL.

tool_signatures.name: open_new_tab
tool_signatures.description: Open a new browser tab, optionally navigating to a URL.

tool_signatures.name: refresh
tool_signatures.description: Refresh the current page.

tool_signatures.name: right_click
tool_signatures.description: Right-click (context menu) on an element.

tool_signatures.name: scroll_by
tool_signatures.description: Scroll the page by a given number of pixels (positive = down/right).

tool_signatures.name: scroll_to_bottom
tool_signatures.description: Scroll the page to the very bottom.

tool_signatures.name: scroll_to_element
tool_signatures.description: Scroll the page to bring an element into view.

tool_signatures.name: scroll_to_top
tool_signatures.description: Scroll the page to the very top.

tool_signatures.name: select_option
tool_signatures.description: Select an option from a <select> dropdown by visible text, value, or index.

tool_signatures.name: send_keys
tool_signatures.description: Send a key or key combination to the focused element (or a specific element if selector is given). Use key names like 'tab', 'enter', 'escape', 'up', 'down', 'f5', or combos like 'ctrl+a', 'shift+tab'.

tool_signatures.name: set_cookie
tool_signatures.description: Set a cookie on the current page.

tool_signatures.name: set_local_storage
tool_signatures.description: Set a localStorage key-value pair.

tool_signatures.name: set_session_storage
tool_signatures.description: Set a sessionStorage key-value pair.

tool_signatures.name: start_browser
tool_signatures.description: Start a browser session. Optional — any tool will auto-start Chrome if no browser is open. Use this to choose Firefox, enable headless mode, or set a custom window size.

tool_signatures.name: switch_to_default_content
tool_signatures.description: Switch back to the main page content from inside a frame.

tool_signatures.name: switch_to_frame
tool_signatures.description: Switch focus into an iframe. Provide index (integer), name/id (string), or a CSS/XPath selector.

tool_signatures.name: switch_to_window
tool_signatures.description: Switch to a browser window/tab by index.

tool_signatures.name: take_screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Take a screenshot and return it as base64.

tool_signatures.name: type_in_alert
tool_signatures.description: Type text into a JavaScript prompt dialog, then accept it.

tool_signatures.name: type_text
tool_signatures.description: Clear and type text into an input field.

tool_signatures.name: upload_file
tool_signatures.description: Upload a file by sending its absolute path to an <input type='file'> element.

tool_signatures.name: wait_for_element
tool_signatures.description: Wait until an element is visible on the page.

tool_signatures.name: wait_for_network_idle
tool_signatures.description: Wait until there are no active XHR/fetch requests for a quiet period. Essential for SPAs and pages that load data asynchronously. Also waits for document.readyState to be 'complete'.
